shortDescription: This module manages snapshot policy configuration on IBM Storage Virtualize family systems

options.name: backupinterval
options.description: Specifies the backup interval. Applies when I(state=present).

options.name: backupstarttime
options.description: Specifies the start time of backup in the format YYMMDDHHMM. Applies when I(state=present).

options.name: backupunit
options.description: Specifies the backup unit in mentioned metric. Applies when I(state=present).

options.name: clustername
options.description: The hostname or management IP of the Storage Virtualize system.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain for the Storage Virtualize system. Valid when hostname is used for the parameter I(clustername).

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies a unique name or UUID of the snapshot policy. Not applicable when I(state=suspend) or I(state=resume).

options.name: old_name
options.description: Specifies the old name or UUID of the snapshot policy during renaming. Valid when I(state=present), to rename an existing snapshot policy.

options.name: password
options.description: REST API password for the Storage Virtualize system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: removefromvolumegroups
options.description: Specify to remove the volume group association from the snapshot policy. Applies when I(state=absent). This option is allowed only for SecurityAdmin users.

options.name: retentiondays
options.description: Specifies the retention days for the backup. Applies when I(state=present).

options.name: state
options.description: Creates (C(present)) or deletes (C(absent)) a snapshot policy. Resume (C(resume)) or suspend (C(suspend)) the snapshot policy, system-wide.

options.name: token
options.description: The authentication token to verify a user on the Storage Virtualize system. To generate a token, use the M(ibm.storage_virtualize.ibm_svc_auth) module.

options.name: username
options.description: REST API username for the Storage Virtualize system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.
